correction.text: the shape as drawn, Elephantine to Cusae, for -1582..-1551 only

keyframe_review.note: -1600..-1501, 34,737 km2, bbox 24.1-27.7 N, 30.6-33.9 E: Upper Egypt from Aswan (Elephantine, 24.09 N) to Cusae and Hermopolis (27.4-27.8 N). Right for Kamose's time: 'They controlled Upper Egypt up to Elephantine' and his campaign 'first reached Nefrusy, which was just north of Cusae'; the Hyksos held the north from there. The pages do not give the limits before Kamose's year 3 and the 16th Dynasty's realm (Edfu to Hu) is smaller, so the early years are unverified. Years: the dynasty runs c. 1580-c. 1550 (infobox), so the shape holds -1580..-1551; -1600..-1583 are the Sixteenth Dynasty's at Thebes, and -1550..-1501 the Eighteenth's. No area on the pages for comparison.

region.text: Upper Egypt from Elephantine to Cusae

ledger.note: c. 1580: the Seventeenth Dynasty rules from Thebes. Infobox 'Established: c. 1580 BC', 'Capital: Thebes'; 'ruled in Upper Egypt during the late Second Intermediate Period'. The page names no land beyond Upper Egypt; the Elephantine-to-Cusae shape is Kamose's time (Kamose page). [Reviewer me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Year set to 1582, the Sixteenth Dynasty's end ('Disestablished: 1582 BC', 'Succeeded by Seventeenth Dynasty of Egypt'), so Thebes has no unowned years between the two; this page's own date is 'c. 1580 BC'.

region.text: the Cusae-Hermopolis borderland, up to Nefrusy

ledger.note: c. 1553: Kamose sails north against the Hyksos. 'In Kamose's third year, he embarked on his military campaign against the Hyksos by sailing north out of Thebes'; 'He first reached Nefrusy, which was just north of Cusae' (1555-1550 reign: year 3 = 1553). The page holds that Kamose probably never attacked Avaris. [Author fix me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Zone moved from Asyut 80 km (reached Sohag, south of Cusae) to lon 30.82, lat 27.6, 60 km between Cusae and Hermopolis, the same circle as the fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt and hyksos dossiers (Kamose page: 'He first reached Nefrusy, which was just north of Cusae'; the frontier moved 'northward from Cusae past Hermopolis through to Sako').

c. 1550: Kamose dies and Ahmose I takes over the war. Infobox 'Died: 1550 BC'; Ahmose 'made the final conquest of them and united all of Egypt'. [Author fix me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Zone moved from Asyut 80 km (reached Sohag, south of Cusae) to lon 30.82, lat 27.6, 60 km between Cusae and Hermopolis, the same circle as the fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt and hyksos dossiers (Kamose page: 'He first reached Nefrusy, which was just north of Cusae'; the frontier moved 'northward from Cusae past Hermopolis through to Sako').

ledger.note: c. 1550: the Seventeenth Dynasty ends and Ahmose I founds the Eighteenth. Infobox 'Disestablished: c. 1550 BC', 'Succeeded by Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt'; Kamose 'last king of the Seventeenth Dynasty' (1555-1550). The page's narrative says the war was 'Beginning The New Kingdom of Egypt'.

wars.name: Seqenenre Tao's attack on the Hyksos
wars.outcome: Seqenenre Tao 'was killed in the battle' of the first wave of attacks 'toward the southern flank'; no land changed hands.
wars.note: The table gives Tao 'c. 1560 (4 years)'; the Second Intermediate Period page dates Seqenenre c. 1549-1545.

wars.name: Kamose's Nubian campaigns
wars.outcome: No result stated: 'Kamose is known to have campaigned against the Kushites prior to his third year'; a second campaign 'in his Year 4 or 5', whose target 'may have been the fortress at Buhen'.
wars.note: The Seventeenth Dynasty page says the Thebans 'maintained mostly peaceful relationships with the Nubians and Hyksos'.

wars.name: Ahmose I's reconquest of Egypt from the Hyksos
wars.outcome: Kamose's sortie to Nefrusy (year 3) opens the war that Ahmose I wins at Avaris and Sharuhen.
wars.note: [Author fix me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Zone recentred as in ledger /1.

notes:
Cliopatria's shape fits Kamose's frontiers (Elephantine to Cusae). The Seventeenth Dynasty page itself gives no territory (the southern and northern limits, the Nubian and Hyksos relations are 'not stated'); the Kamose page supplies them for the last years only.
Page conflicts: Tao 'c. 1560 (4 years)' and Kamose '1555-1550 (5 years)' on this page, but 'died suddenly after just 2 years' in the narrative; the Second Intermediate Period page dates Seqenenre c. 1549-1545 and Kamose c. 1545-1540; the dynasty c. 1571-1540 on that page against c. 1580-c. 1550 in the infobox. The page's 'In 1559 BC, led by ... Ahmose I, they conquered the city of Memphis. Then, with naval support, conquered Hutwaret [Avaris]' then Sharuhen 'for 3 years' dates the fall of the Hyksos nine years before the other pages and before Kamose's year-3 sortie that stopped at Cusae: not drawn (see the Fifteenth Dynasty and New Kingdom dossiers).
Not drawn: a Kush alliance (Redford on Egyptians 'in the service of the king of Kush', undated); Hyksos tribute (page silent). Abydos Dynasty (c. 1640-1620) needs a dossier or a decision (suggested slug abydos-dynasty). Kingdom of Kerma (counterpart of the Nubian campaigns) needs a dossier. The ruler strip is omitted: reign lengths are missing for five of nine kings.
